{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in customer_age
customer_age_missing = sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum()

# Check the data type of customer_age
customer_age_dtype = sales_df['customer_age'].dtype

# Check the distribution of customer_age
customer_age_stats = sales_df['customer_age'].describe()

# Display the results
customer_age_missing, customer_age_dtype, customer_age_stats"}
